zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you want to hire people from abroad, let's say, before we get to AI.
zh: 你想从国外雇人，比如说，在我们谈到 AI 之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I say, well, you know, if you do that, you're going to push out the labor supply curve.
zh: 然后我说，好吧，你知道吗，如果你那么做，你会把劳动供给曲线往外推。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm no dummy.
zh: 所以我不傻。

speaker: Unknown
en: The price where supply meets demand, the point where that happens is my wage.
zh: 供给与需求相遇的那个价格点，就是我的工资。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you push out the supply curve, my wage is going to go down unless something pulls up the demand.
zh: 所以如果你把供给曲线往外推，我的工资就会下降，除非有什么东西把需求拉上去。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what I'm going to do is I'm going to say, look, I'm happy to have my wage go down.
zh: 所以我要做的是，我会说，听着，我很乐意让我的工资下降。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I want licensing income where I get a cut of what you get from being able to hire, let's say, more taxi drivers.
zh: 但我想要许可收入，也就是我能从你那里分得一部分，因为你能够雇用，比如说，更多的出租车司机。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm the only American taxi driver in New York City.
zh: 我是纽约市唯一的美国出租车司机。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you say, I have to bring in a bunch of people from Gambia and Uzbekistan and whatnot.
zh: 而你说，我必须从 Gambia 和 Uzbekistan 之类的国家引进一批人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You say, okay, I'll license you.
zh: 你说，好吧，我会向你购买许可。

speaker: Unknown
en: You will buy the right to import those people from me.
zh: 你要从我这里买走引进那些人的权利。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my wage income will go down, my licensing income will go up, and my blended income will increase, and your blended income will increase.
zh: 我的工资收入会下降，我的许可收入会上升，我的综合收入会增加，而你的综合收入也会增加。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the proper way to do immigration.
zh: 这才是处理移民问题的正确方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you would be my employee, and you would have the right to...
zh: 所以你会是我的雇员，而且你会有权利去……

speaker: Unknown
en: basically approve me bringing in.
zh: 基本上就是批准我引进。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I'm a doctor and I've trained, I've invested and you're saying, look, I have to be able to hire the best and the brightest Eric.
zh: 如果我是一名医生，我受过训练，我做了投资，然后你说，听着，我必须能雇到最优秀最聪明的人，Eric。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's face it.
zh: 我们得面对现实。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a dog eat dog world.
zh: 这是一个弱肉强食的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, uh, I think you're just not that good.
zh: 而且，呃，我觉得你就是没那么优秀。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I want to be able to, you know, to go to mum room grand hospital in Thailand and, and hire their doctors.
zh: 所以我希望能够，你知道，去泰国的 Mum Room Grand 医院，雇佣他们的医生。

speaker: Unknown
en: I should say fine.
zh: 我应该说没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Knock yourself out.
zh: 随便你。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do I have to ask you?
zh: 我有什么要问你的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I had, why did you need labor certification?
zh: 因为我，你为什么需要劳工认证？

speaker: Unknown
en: I have rights to my labor market.
zh: 我对我的劳动力市场拥有权利。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's how, that's how we play the game.
zh: 这就是，这就是我们玩这个游戏的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's how everybody in the U.S. gets a cut.
zh: 这就是为什么美国的每个人都能分一杯羹。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why you're not looking at Brazilian inequality levels yet.
zh: 这也是为什么你还没有看到巴西那种不平等程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is because we have a way of distributing the wealth of this country, which is that you get first access to the world's richest labor market.
zh: 是因为我们有一种分配这个国家财富的方式，那就是你能优先进入世界上最富有的劳动力市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you did a PhD.
zh: 因为你读了个博士。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I was born here.
zh: 我怎么压榨劳动力，这是每一个大公司 CEO 的梦想。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you're born here.
zh: 因为你出生在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Congratulations.
zh: 恭喜你。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why it's valuable to have a U.S. citizenship or permanent residency.
zh: 这就是为什么拥有美国公民身份或永久居留权是有价值的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if I put you out of work, you then will get a full... You'll still get your money.
zh: 所以如果我把你挤出工作岗位，你就会得到全额……你还是会拿到你的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're not going to put me out of work.
zh: 你不会把我挤出工作岗位的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm just going to have my income go down.
zh: 我只是会让我的收入下降。

speaker: Unknown
en: In other words, the basic idea is...
zh: 换句话说，基本的想法是……

speaker: Unknown
en: employers try to make American workers, and I'm doing it for the U.S., but it could be Britain or it could be France or it could be India, it doesn't matter.
zh: 雇主试图对付美国工人，我这里说的是美国，但也可以是英国、法国或印度，都无所谓。

speaker: Unknown
en: The whole game is that employers want to conceptualize the blockage to hire from abroad as red tape.
zh: 整个游戏就是，雇主想把从国外招聘的障碍概念化为繁文缛节。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're freeing red tape.
zh: 我们在废除繁文缛节。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going after the best.
zh: 我们在追求最优秀的人才。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is total nonsense.
zh: 这完全是胡说八道。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is, you know, a theory known as the Borjas rectangle and the Harberger triangle.
zh: 这就是，你知道，一个叫做 Borjas 矩形和 Harberger 三角的理论。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can diagram it out for you on a whiteboard.
zh: 我可以在白板上给你画出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what is really happening is that a tiny inefficiency known as the Harberger triangle sits on top of a giant structure called the Borjas rectangle.
zh: 而真正发生的是，一个叫做 Harberger 三角的小小低效率，坐落在叫做 Borjas 矩形的巨大结构之上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And nobody cares about the Harberger triangle.
zh: 而没人在乎 Harberger 三角。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a tiny little inefficiency.
zh: 它只是一个很小的低效率。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody's salivating over labor's share of the labor market.
zh: 每个人都在垂涎劳动力在劳动力市场中的份额。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I screw over labor is the dream of every CEO of a large company.
zh: 如何压垮劳动者是每一家大公司 CEO 的梦想。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this model, AI becomes just another supplier of labor.
zh: 在这个模型中，AI 只是成为劳动力的另一个供应者。

speaker: Unknown
en: The workers license that.
zh: 工人对此进行了授权。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now, what we have is just out-and-out theft.
zh: 而现在，我们面对的是赤裸裸的盗窃。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because the corpus, all of human achievement has been tokenized.
zh: 因为语料库，全人类的成就已经被 token 化了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's been taken by the AI and it's been...
zh: 它被 AI 拿走了，而且被……

speaker: Unknown
en: It's taken in persistent storage, you know?
zh: 它被放进了持久化存储，你知道吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, right now, people who are watching us on YouTube are not watching us.
zh: 比如，现在，在 YouTube 上看我们的人并不是在看我们直播。

speaker: Unknown
en: You and I are no longer here.
zh: 你和我已经不在这里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is long since I've gone home, you've gone home, you've had several guests since.
zh: 这是很久以前了，我已经回家了，你也回家了，这之后你已经录了好几位嘉宾了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got tokenized.
zh: 我们被 token 化了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got tokenized.
zh: 我们被 token 化了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got put into persistent storage as these shreds of ourselves.
zh: 我们作为自我的碎片被放进了持久化存储。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's enough, the trace of that conversation.
zh: 但这就够了，那段对话的痕迹。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now you can hit the auto transcript generation on YouTube and it'll give you what all of our words are.
zh: 现在你可以在 YouTube 上点击自动生成转录稿，它会给你我们所有的原话。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can do frequency analysis.
zh: 你可以做频率分析。

speaker: Unknown
en: How often does Eric use the double copula, which is this grammatical quirk that creeps into my speech?
zh: Eric 多常使用双重系动词，也就是悄悄溜进我 speech 里的这种语法怪癖？

speaker: Unknown
en: How often does Stephen say, um, that's...
zh: Stephen 多常说，呃，那是……

speaker: Unknown
en: Whatever it is, we're being tokenized at an incredible level, and then we're being rigged inside of the AI.
zh: 不管是什么，我们正在被以前所未有的程度 token 化，然后被装配进 AI 里面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Voluntarily?
zh: 自愿的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不是。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, completely non-consensually.
zh: 不是，完全是在未经同意的情况下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Completely non-consensually.
zh: 完全是在未经同意的情况下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it non-consensual because you're aware of that and you still came and sat here to be tokenized?
zh: 说是未经同意，但你明知如此，还是来坐在这里被 token 化了？

speaker: Unknown
en: Have you ever tried getting through a day without signing anything that you don't want to sign?
zh: 你有没有试过一整天下来，不签任何你不想签的东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, more or less, you probably either rent or have a mortgage.
zh: 我是说，多多少少，你可能要么租房要么有房贷。

speaker: Unknown
en: I guarantee you, if you have a mortgage, you didn't read everything.
zh: 我敢保证，如果你有房贷，你没有读完全部条款。

speaker: Unknown
en: Giant stack of paper.
zh: 一大摞文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't understand it.
zh: 你看不懂。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're constantly forced to pretend that you voluntarily, like, you know, we say ignorance of the law is no excuse.
zh: 你不断被迫假装自己是自愿的，你知道，我们说「不知法律不免责」。

speaker: Unknown
en: If every judge who said ignorance of the law is no excuse were given an instant spot quiz as to what the US code says, do you think they'd pass?
zh: 如果每个说「不知法律不免责」的法官都被当场突击测验美国法典的内容，你觉得他们能及格吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不能。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how does this pertain to AI?
zh: 那这和 AI 有什么关系？

speaker: Unknown
en: The example you gave of importing foreign labor, how would that pertain to a new model for AI in distributing the value?
zh: 你举的引进外国劳工的例子，这会如何对应到一个分配价值的 AI 新模式？

speaker: Unknown
en: The reason that these people are getting so rich is that this is an uncompensated theft.
zh: 这些人变得这么富有的原因是，这是一种没有补偿的盗窃。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't know how to police it.
zh: 我们不知道该怎么治理它。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got Bernie Sanders saying, pay everybody a little share.
zh: 我们有 Bernie Sanders 在说，给每个人分一小份。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, screw you, man.
zh: 这就像，去你的，老兄。

speaker: Unknown
en: I work really hard on the things that I do.
zh: 我在自己的事情上非常努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I've got Bernie Sanders and my friend Andrew Yang going on about the socialism stuff.
zh: 然后我有 Bernie Sanders 还有我朋友 Andrew Yang 在那里大谈社会主义那套。

speaker: Unknown
en: Socialism is spiritual and mental poison.
zh: 社会主义是精神上和思想上的毒药。

speaker: Unknown
en: And normally when people say that, they're saying it from the point of view of they're really money focused.
zh: 通常人们说这话的时候，是从他们真的很看重金钱的角度说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it has nothing to do with anything.
zh: 而这和任何东西都没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just can't stand collectivism.
zh: 我只是无法忍受集体主义。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love individuality.
zh: 我热爱个体性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, you know, when I hear people who go on an anti-individualist rant, particularly, you know, this could be, there's no lone genius theory anymore.
zh: 所以，你知道，当我听到人们发表反个体主义的长篇大论，尤其是，你知道，这可能是，已经没有孤独天才理论了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We all know lone genius theory is not, well, we have fantastic evidence of lone geniuses from Isaac Newton to Aristotle to, you know, whoever.
zh: 我们都知道孤独天才理论不是——嗯，从 Isaac Newton 到 Aristotle 到随便谁，我们有关于孤独天才的绝佳证据。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, there shouldn't be any billionaires.
zh: 嗯，本来不应该有亿万富翁。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, really?
zh: 哦，是吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you know what billionaires actually do with their billions?
zh: 你知道亿万富翁实际上用他们的几十亿在做什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: They allocate.
zh: 他们在做配置。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't sit there and just consume it.
zh: 他们不是坐在那里只是消费它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not saying that the rich don't consume opulently, but most of that money is allocated.
zh: 我不是说富人不会奢侈地消费，但那些钱大部分是被配置掉的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What we're having is an inability to reckon with the fact that the AI is normalizing theft, is going to destroy the labor market.
zh: 我们现在面临的是无法正视这样一个事实：AI 正在把盗窃正常化，将会摧毁劳动力市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one is convening conferences that are at the level of the threat.
zh: 没有人在召开与这个威胁同等级别的会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to lose this beautiful mesh that provides us freedom.
zh: 我们将会失去这张为我们提供自由的美丽网络。

speaker: Unknown
en: I chose to come here today.
zh: 我今天是自己选择来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we were both doing this out of freedom.
zh: 但我们俩做这件事都是出于自由。

speaker: Unknown
en: You had lovely snacks in your green room.
zh: 你的绿色休息室里有很棒的零食。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's an array of equipment here.
zh: 这里有一整排设备。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've come up with a beautiful set.
zh: 你们布置了一套很漂亮的场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, really appreciate it.
zh: 你知道，真的很感激。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of that was voluntary.
zh: 这一切都是自愿的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a sum of choices.
zh: 它是一系列选择的总和。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want that going away.
zh: 我不想看到这些消失。

speaker: Unknown
en: This mesh that governs our lives, that gives us purpose when we get up in the morning, that gives us signals, that tells us, you're doing a good job, you're doing a bad job.
zh: 这张治理我们生活的网络，它在我们早上起床时给我们目标，给我们信号，告诉我们，你做得好，你做得不好。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not perfect.
zh: 它并不完美。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some people, it doesn't serve well.
zh: 对一些人来说，它服务得不好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've had times in my life when I've just said, I cannot buy a base hit and I'm doing a great job.
zh: 我人生中有过这样的时刻:我就是打不出一支安特打,而我干得很出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's going on?
zh: 这是怎么回事?

speaker: Unknown
en: I've had other times when I think I'm not doing a great job and I'm getting rewarded.
zh: 我也有过另一些时候,我觉得自己干得不怎么样,却得到了回报。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's not perfect.
zh: 所以它并不完美。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a great morality play the way capitalists always portray it.
zh: 它不像资本家总是描绘的那样,是一出伟大的道德剧。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it is freedom.
zh: 但它是自由。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's sort of on average pretty good.
zh: 而且总体上平均来看相当不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're in danger of losing that because the model of production, the K&L model, where this interview is an input of capital and the microphones, the lighting, the video storage, and labor.
zh: 我们正处于失去它的危险之中,因为生产模式——K&L 模式——这次访谈是资本的一种投入,还有麦克风、灯光、视频存储和劳动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're sitting down.
zh: 你坐下了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sitting down.
zh: 我坐下了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, what is AI?
zh: 那么 AI 是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it capital?
zh: 它是资本吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure looks like labor to me.
zh: 在我看来它分明像是劳动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it labor?
zh: 它是劳动力吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a human.
zh: 它不是人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So right now we're in some situation where we're going to break capitalism and we're going to break freedom.
zh: 所以现在我们处在某种境地,我们要搞垮资本主义,我们要搞垮自由。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to break markets.
zh: 我们要搞垮市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've talked about this in an article called Anthropic Capitalism, saying that capitalism versus communism was a really funny thing to think about because it's sort of saying, pardon me for being slightly graphic, capitalism and communism are more like Thelma and Louise.
zh: 我在一篇叫《Anthropic 资本主义》的文章里谈过这个,说资本主义对共产主义是个很滑稽的思考对象,因为这么说吧——恕我讲得有点直白——资本主义和共产主义更像《末路狂花》里的 Thelma 和 Louise。

speaker: Unknown
en: And saying that, well, Thelma hit the ground first does not mean that Louise won.
zh: 说 Thelma 先落地,并不意味着 Louise 就赢了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: okay, communism blew up first.
zh: 好吧,共产主义先爆炸了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Capitalism shortly thereafter.
zh: 资本主义紧接着。

speaker: Unknown
en: If Marx and Adam Smith and all of these people who came up with the theory of social organization were sitting around now, I don't think they'd be debating capitalism versus communism.
zh: 如果马克思、亚当·斯密以及所有这些提出社会组织理论的人现在坐在一起,我认为他们不会在辩论资本主义对共产主义。

speaker: Unknown
en: They'd be talking about what's next.
zh: 他们会讨论接下来是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And none of our leaders know to do this.
zh: 而我们的领袖们没有人知道该怎么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: None of our academic leaders know.
zh: 我们的学术领袖没有人知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: None of our business leaders, none of our political leaders.
zh: 我们的商界领袖没有,政界领袖也没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are no high-profile series of conferences.
zh: 没有一系列高知名度的会议。

en: My phone is not ringing.
zh: 我的电话没有响。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody's phone is ringing.
zh: 没有人的电话在响。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're just having, we had this incredible luncheon at the White House.
zh: 我们只是在——我们在白宫参加了一场非凡的午宴。

speaker: Unknown
en: The future of superintelligence.
zh: 超级智能的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think there were physicists or mathematicians or biologists or composers or writers.
zh: 我不认为那里有物理学家、数学家、生物学家、作曲家或作家。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was just like wall-to-wall national interest in business types.
zh: 到处都是对国家利益感兴趣的商界人士。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's insane.
zh: 太疯狂了。

en: Stephen, let me just hit a theme.
zh: Stephen,让我提一个主题。

en: I think you can pretty much prove that more or less something approaching 100% of the population has gone completely insane.
zh: 我认为你基本可以证明,或多或少接近 100% 的人口已经彻底疯了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can see it everywhere.
zh: 而且你到处都能看到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I say, okay,
zh: 如果我说,好吧,

zh: 你鼓励人们生孩子，但你也警告说文明可能会崩溃。

speaker: Unknown
en: Feels like a...
zh: 这感觉像是一个……

speaker: Unknown
en: If we don't want civilization to collapse, we better have some babies, because civilization is about babies.
zh: 如果我们不想让文明崩溃，我们最好生些孩子，因为文明的核心就是孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you can't figure out that babies are the key to civilization, you've got bigger problems than taking advice from me.
zh: 如果你搞不明白孩子是文明的关键，那你面临的问题比听我的建议要严重得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would say that be of good cheer.
zh: 我想说，要保持愉快的心情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Get super excited.
zh: 要极度地兴奋起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't worry about being called arrogant or delusional if everyone is in fact crazy.
zh: 不要害怕被说成傲慢或妄想，如果事实上所有人都是疯子的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Watch the world through your own eyes first and then correct it to what everybody tells you you should be seeing second.
zh: 先用自己的眼睛看这个世界，然后再参照大家告诉你的“你应该看到什么”去修正，这是第二步。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're seeing a world that is fictitious.
zh: 你看到的是一个虚构的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're watching professional wrestling constantly.
zh: 你一直在看的是职业摔跤表演。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have that sense that everything is off, congratulations.
zh: 如果你有那种“一切都哪里不对劲”的感觉，恭喜你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Believe in yourself.
zh: 相信你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: Recognize that it is incumbent upon you to lie in your life so that you can fit in with all of these systems.
zh: 要认识到，你一生中是不得不说谎的，这样才能融入所有这些体制。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're entitled to a hypocrisy budget.
zh: 你有资格获得一份虚伪预算。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're entitled to a sloth budget, an envy budget.
zh: 你有权拥有一个懒惰额度，一个嫉妒额度。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're entitled to be a sinner.
zh: 你有权做一个罪人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're entitled to fail.
zh: 你有权失败。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just try to stay within your budgets.
zh: 只要尽量待在你的额度之内。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do not proceed as if you're trying to get rid of your hypocrisy, because you'll certainly fail.
zh: 不要表现得好像你要彻底摆脱你的虚伪，因为你肯定会失败。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't try to get rid of all of the things that make you human.
zh: 不要试图摆脱所有那些让你成为人类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And recognize that at the moment, when all of our mistakes are compounding, because we're in a digital format that never forgets anything,
zh: 并且要认识到，此刻，我们所有的错误都在不断累积，因为我们处于一种永远不会遗忘任何东西的数字化形态之中，

speaker: Unknown
en: You're entitled to so many screw ups that you're not taking.
zh: 你有权拥有那么多你没有利用的搞砸机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just be compassionate with yourself.
zh: 只是要对自己有同情心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then once you've done that, extend that to the guy who just cut you off in traffic, the person who just stabbed you in the back a little bit at work, because.
zh: 然后一旦你做到了这一点，就把这份同情延伸到那个刚刚在开车时别了你的人，那个刚刚在工作中稍微在背后捅了你一刀的人，因为——

speaker: Unknown
en: You're talking about that plane pilot thing again.
zh: 你又说起那个飞机飞行员的事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, that would be stabbing you right in the... By the way, shout out to this Indian hero of a pilot and the Israelis who came in and saved the day once the cockpit door was opened.
zh: 不，那可是直接捅在你正……顺便说一句，向这位印度的英雄飞行员致敬，还有那些在驾驶舱门被打开后冲进来力挽狂澜的以色列人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just two of the countries I love most in the world because they're both just giant celebrations of life.
zh: 正好是我最爱的两个国家，因为它们都只是对生命的巨大礼赞。

speaker: Unknown
en: And remember that the life cults are more powerful than the death cults.
zh: 并且要记住，生命崇拜比死亡崇拜更强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you've got to really enjoy...
zh: 但你必须真正地享受……

speaker: Unknown
en: heroism and people who are agentic taking risks, taking charge, and taking care of the weak and people who can't take care of themselves.
zh: 英雄主义，以及那些有主观能动性的人——冒险、担当、照顾弱者和那些无法照顾自己的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks, Stephen.
zh: 谢谢你，Stephen。

speaker: Unknown
en: Really appreciate having me back here.
zh: 真的很感激能再次来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for coming back.
zh: 谢谢你再次前来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's always a pleasure.
zh: 一直都很愉快。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's always an intellectual expansion.
zh: 一直都能带来智识上的拓展。
